name: ita-matrix
title: ITA Matrix
description: MCP server for ITA Matrix airfare search, with multi-city and routing-language support

environment.name: ITA_MATRIX_SECRET_PATH
environment.description: Mounts MCP at /mcp/<secret>; the URL then acts as the credential.

environment.name: ITA_MATRIX_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environment.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist, guarding against DNS rebinding.

environment.name: ITA_MATRIX_API_KEY
environment.description: Pin the upstream API key instead of discovering it.

environment.name: ITA_MATRIX_CACHE_DIR
environment.description: Directory for the 30-day cache of the discovered API key.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.title: Search flights (multi-city capable)
tools.description: Search ITA Matrix for itineraries. 1-6 legs: one-way, round-trip, multi-city or open-jaw, each with its own routing code.

tools.name: get_itinerary_details
tools.title: Expand one itinerary
tools.description: Per-segment booking class, fare basis and aircraft for one itinerary from a previous search, plus an agent brief and booking links.

tools.name: search_flexible_dates
tools.title: Find the cheapest dates
tools.description: Scan a range of departure dates and report the cheapest fare on each.

tools.name: lookup_airport
tools.title: Look up airport / city codes
tools.description: Resolve a partial city or airport name to IATA codes, including metro codes.

tools.name: routing_language_reference
tools.title: ITA routing language reference
tools.description: Full syntax for the routing and extraCodes fields.

prompts.name: plan_trip
prompts.title: Plan a trip
prompts.description: Turn a trip described in plain words into a sequence of Matrix searches, ending with the best one to three priced options.

prompts.name: hunt_premium_fare
prompts.title: Hunt for a premium-cabin fare
prompts.description: Look for a cheap business or first fare by varying the origin, then narrowing by alliance and fare bucket.

prompts.name: explain_empty_search
prompts.title: Explain an empty search
prompts.description: Work out why a search returned nothing by relaxing one constraint at a time, then checking whether Matrix itself is responding.

resources.title: ITA routing language reference
resources.description: Syntax for the routing and extraCodes fields, with worked examples.

resources.title: Fare strategy guide
resources.description: Search order and tactics for finding cheaper fares with Matrix.
